parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The format is the same as StartTime.

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description:
The monitoring metrics name. Valid values:
- delivery_sls_success_count: the number of logs successfully delivered to Simple Log Service (SLS).
- delivery_sls_fail_count: the number of logs that failed to be delivered to SLS.
- delivery_oss_success_count: the number of logs successfully delivered to Object Storage Service (OSS).
- delivery_oss_fail_count: the number of logs that failed to be delivered to OSS.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The statistical period of the monitoring data. The minimum value is 60. Multiples of 60 are supported.

Recommended values: 60, 900, and 3600. Unit: seconds.
